title: Errands
description: A small list you can actually keep: add items, tick them done, archive instead of delete. The list is stored only in this browser, on this device. Nothing is shared or synced.

sections.heading: Why this page
sections.body: This is daya's first step toward generating code for an existing app: the core of a todo list (add, done, archive, restore) from one recipe section. No account, no server; the list lives only in this browser.
